# ♿ Accessibility audit

## Audit metadata
Date, reviewer, commit, browser, OS, viewport, screen reader, and tools.

## Scope
List routes, components, states, and excluded areas.

## Test matrix
| Area | Method | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyboard | Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter/Escape | | |
| Focus | Visible, order, restore | | |
| Screen reader | Labels, live regions, dialog | | |
| Contrast | Text and UI boundaries | | |
| Reflow | Zoom and narrow viewport | | |
| Motion | Reduced motion preference | | |

## Findings
Include severity, affected control, reproduction, expected behavior, and remediation.

## Conformance statement
State only the tested scope and evidence. Do not claim WCAG conformance from an automated scan alone.
